notes.title: Dev Update: Dash, Phone Booth, and a Hearty Thank You!
notes.content: [p]And with that, we're in September! Every turn of the month, I sit down and write one of these updates. And I always have no clue where the time went.[/p][p]Happy to report that I'm making progress on the game and finalizing the last of the plot. Lots of behind-the-scene work I've been tackling (that I can't talk about). I think we'll still make the 2025 release, but there is a possibility for early 2026 (sorry!)[/p][p]Anyways, here are some updates![/p][p][/p][h1]Meet Dash![/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44735780/3013ef824dbf3e87de07829f4fd42e540d78240a.png"][/img][/p][p]I've gotten lots of questions asking what the coins are for. Well Dash (the Haberdashery) has answers for you! They're an economy expert! They'll revitalize the local industry! And they're here to sell you hats (in exchange for your coins).[/p][p]Can't wait for you all to meet this dashing building :)[/p][p][i](note that you unfortunately can't date Dash, they're too invested in their 'work')[/i][/p][p][/p][h1]Hello, hello?[/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44735780/5740e5abdffb897fb57007d7bb55eb26e763a381.png"][/img][/p][p]"Sorry, excuse me -- I'm on my phone."[/p][p]I added this phone booth to the game and well... I'm really excited for the dialogue related to the phone booth. I think it's truly the worst thing I've ever written (positive).[/p][p][/p][h1]And a big THANK YOU for your support![/h1][p]It's been a year since I moved back home to work on Building Relationships, and I just want to say that I'm incredibly grateful for each and everyone of you! I really needed a break from the corporate environment, and working on this game has been such a healing process for me. Making a game is not easy, finding an audience for the game is not easy, so I'm just really thankful for all the wishlists, nice messages, encouragements, etc.[/p][p]I hope the game will connect with you, in the same way it's allowed me to re-connect with myself.[/p][p][/p][h1][url="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44735780/c5ec5506150b912052c5f6dc5d3f236beafac5c1.gif"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44735780/c5ec5506150b912052c5f6dc5d3f236beafac5c1.gif"][/img][/url] thank you for reading! [url="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44735780/c5ec5506150b912052c5f6dc5d3f236beafac5c1.gif"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44735780/c5ec5506150b912052c5f6dc5d3f236beafac5c1.gif"][/img][/url][/h1]

BitSummit where the game was nominated for the "Innovative Outlaw Award"![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44735780/7b997a6d1367c8d965af2d20332c11f04598952a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]It was really cool to notes.title: Dev Update: Rhythm minigame, and... Pole Dancing?

WILD![/p][p]Anyways, June was pretty nice to me -- lots of progress on the game, time well spent with friends, and even performed a [url="https://www.instagram.com/p/DLUjQNPhTfm/"]pole choreography[/url] to Glass Cages from Rift of the Necrodancer! It just feels nice to finally find some sort of rhythm when you're your own boss, I'm trying to ride the momentum all the way to release![/p][p]Time for updates![/p][p][/p][h2]Big Thanks to Everyone Who's Played the Demo![/h2][p]It means a lot to me! notes.title: Dev Update: I added yearning to the game (+ SGF, Six One, Beyond Game Jam)
notes.content:
[p]Hello fellow structures! I hope you're all doing well :)[/p][p]Working on this game has been rocky at times, but I've been feeling a lot better about it! Progress is going smoothly, the pieces are slowly falling into place, and I'm so excited for y'all to experience the whole thing![/p][p]Anyways, here's some updates!![/p][p][/p][h1]Happy Pride Month![/h1][p]Building Relationships is a deeply [i]weird[/i] game. It's unserious at times, freaky at times -- but to me, it's a celebration of queer romance. So I hope that everyone is having a wonderful pride month![/p][p][/p][p]Anyways, here's a very naked look of the game from early on.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44735780/2ddc7cbcffa7affac35be1ff04b368b4e978a9e7.jpg"][/img][/p][h1]I added yearning into the game![/h1][p]I've been working on the later sections of the game and I can't fully share everything I'm working on. So here's a look at the buildings yearning![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44735780/e370cd958204d6036ba9db3de9dcc5b5fb172079.png"][/img][/p][p]Fun fact: The game currently crashes if I try to stop the yearning.[/p][p][/p][h1]We're part of Southeast Asian Games Showcase![/h1][p]Building Relationships was announced at last year's Summer Game Fest, and I'm so happy to be a part of SGF again this year (this time with Southeast Asian Games Showcase)![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="Oe4Pm3nYGv8;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Don't forget to take a peek at all the awesome games in the showcase (here's the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/sale/southeastasiangamesshowcase"]link[/url] to the steam event)[/p][p][/p][h1]Six One Indie[/h1][p]This was a couple of weeks ago, but Building Relationships was also in the Six One Indie Showcase! A bunch of unique indie games here as well :)[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="adI4uizTYN4;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h1]Beyond Game Jam Talk[/h1][p]I'm also giving a talk later this month about making games with free assets, specifically on the joy & perspective that emerges when you're forced to be scrappy.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44735780/7cfb2d2c1b37c0c7bae1831c51285fb0448c809e.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]If you're a developer looking for a game jam to join, then check out the jam [url="https://itch.io/jam/beyond-game-jam"]here[/url].[/p]

notes.title: The Demo Update Where I Addressed All Your Feedback
notes.content:
Hello fellow structures,

Just wanted to say thanks for everyone who's downloaded the demo, given it a try, and left a review on the demo page! This game means a lot to me, and it really warms my heart to receive so much love and support <3

I've heard the feedback, I've made the fixes and have uploaded an updated demo with the following fixes:
[list]
[*] The camera is easier to control now
[*] The camera now inverts properly (I think)
[*] The dating minigame no longer takes place in purgatory
[*] The dating minigame has been sped up and now includes a bit of a narrative hook
[*] You can now collect every fish in the journal (if you break the game a little)
[*] The music is not as loud (sorry)
[*] The jump sound is less annoying (it holds the note instead of sliding)
[*] Objective and Coin UI looks a little better now
[*] Misc localization fixes (I don't remember the whole list)
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44735780/7b54e5fbff1c78014d3922c23563ec0da9b55851.png[/img]

This has been such a wild year for me, I'm eternally grateful that I get a chance to pursue indie game development. I'm working hard on finishing the rest of the game, I hope you're excited for the nonsense I have left in store :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44735780/f94c217bedc512002a40e1c717e9213fb3bc1910.png[/img]

notes.title: Building Relationships - July & August Update
notes.content:
Hello fellow structures!

The team has been busy working on the game! We've got more music in the works, areas being refurbished, and more! I've also been a lil bit busy [i]moving house[/i] across continents, so I missed the post for July (oops, sorry).

[h2]Steam Next Fest soon....?[/h2]

Things are progressing along nicely, and we'll hopefully have an improved demo ready for Steam Next Fest in October! Here's what we'll have in store:

[list]
[*] Revamped areas (like the beach), now with secret collectibles to find all over!
[*] Adjusted dialogue, now with character theme tunes for date-able structures!
[*] Movement improvements, making it harder to get stuck places (unless you'd want to be)!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44735780/b53afd659a60bd804651dc88cd352fe2c5150788.png[/img]
[i]Look at this new pier, with chain physics and all![/i]

I've gotten a lot of useful notes from early reception and can't wait to show you all the new improvements! I'm hoping to sneak a portion of the picnic date mini-game, but we'll see 🤞

[h2]Cameo in sister game The Crush House![/h2]

We were also featured alongside a bunch of awesome indies in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2337820/The_Crush_House/]The Crush House[/url]! Take a check if you're looking to film your own reality TV show!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44735780/1ec9e54b22984dc18b156bfcfb8b4a9021ca9dd1.jpg[/img]

[h2]Here's a few places the game has been featured in![/h2]

[h3]Interview with Matt Buckley (on Finally Got Around To)[/h3]
[url=https://www.finallygotaroundto.com/editorials/interview-with-the-creator-of-building-relationships]Read it Here![/url] I said a lot of things in here, including a funny story about how a thermos of pasta got me into Summer Games Fest!

[h3]Did you catch the Dunkey video we were in?[/h3]
[previewyoutube=_faL5eiSjew;full][/previewyoutube]
[i]hehehe[/i]

[h3]Demoed the game at Brighton (UK)![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44735780/061d52a2e07e764c3560cdc0d4f12e0aa2362ba3.jpg[/img]
[i]What do you think of our stickers?[/i]

[h2]That's it for now![/h2]

Looking forward to sharing more with y'all soon!

- Tanat
